text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One key area is text understanding, which allows machines to read and make sense of what people write. NLP also makes translation possible, so tools can quickly change text from one language into another. Another useful example is sentiment analysis, where a computer decides whether a message is positive, negative, or neutral. You can also see NLP at work in chatbots, which answer customer questions online. Thanks to NLP, computers can communicate with us in a more natural and helpful way every day.
